g.text: 6. GPIO2/8/9 are strapping pins (GPIO8 = onboard LED): leave unconnected. GPIO10 is not a strap; R2 holds Q1 off during boot. GPIO20/21 (UART0) kept

g.desc: 6. GPIO2/8/9 are strapping pins (GPIO8 = onboard LED): leave unconnected. GPIO10 is not a strap; R2 holds Q1 off during boot. GPIO20/21 (UART0) kept

g.text: 7. VBAT is tapped on the PCB side of the panel's reverse-polarity diodes D1/D2; one common ground with the panel (CON1-16). F1 limits fault current if D1

g.desc: 7. VBAT is tapped on the PCB side of the panel's reverse-polarity diodes D1/D2; one common ground with the panel (CON1-16). F1 limits fault current if D1

g.text: fails short. D2 blocks USB 5 V back-feeding U1. LM7805: 35 V max input; SMAJ18A clamps ~29 V.

g.desc: fails short. D2 blocks USB 5 V back-feeding U1. LM7805: 35 V max input; SMAJ18A clamps ~29 V.

g.text: 5. R3 = 200R gives 60-70 mA if BTN is a stiff 12-14 V node; raise to 470R-1k if the measured

g.text: pull-up allows. Firmware ignores GPIO3 while Q1 is on and caps press time.
